candidates.title: Wipe after 10 wrong PINs disables the lock first, so the app opens (and stays unlocked if killed) before data is deleted
trace: lib/core/security/app_lock.dart unlockWithPin: disable() deletes lock_hash and sets locked=false before onWipe
lib/core/providers/auth_provider.dart wipeThisDevice awaits network sign-out before deleting data
candidates.fix: Stay locked during the wipe; delete local data first without network; persist a wipe-pending marker.
